questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some Rice are Salad.

II. All Salad are Table.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some Rice are Table.

II. No Salad is Rice.

III. Some Table are Salad.

options.text: Both conclusions II and III follows
Both conclusions I and II follows
Both conclusions I and III follows

questions.solution:
Given Statements:

I. Some Rice are Salad.

II. All Salad are Table.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d95353b6488d6546622319b953287633472a0ffa9df4f0ce2018196261c5a1f.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some Rice are Table - True (Because, Those part of Rice that is Salad will be also Table).

II. No Salad is Rice - False (Because, Some Rice is Salad given in the statement).

III. Some Table are Salad - True (Because, All Table are Salad given, so Some Table are Salad will be also true)

So, Both conclusions I and III follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
